description: Source code for NXP S32 MRU (Mailbox) driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing mailbox communication with interrupt handling, callback registration, and hardware configuration.

methods.name: is_rx_channel_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given channel number is valid based on hardware configuration.

methods.name: get_mbox_addr
methods.description: Calculates mailbox address for a specific channel and mailbox index.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_send
methods.description: Sends a message through the mailbox for a specific channel.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for a specific mailbox channel.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_mtu_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum transmission unit size.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_max_channels_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of channels.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a mailbox channel.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_init
methods.description: Initializes the mailbox hardware and configures interrupts.

methods.name: nxp_s32_mru_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for mailbox events.
